subject: Ilvara Mizzrym
fact: Ilvara Mizzrym is the high priestess of House Mizzrym, Zuggtmoy's beloved instrument, corrupted vessel of a demon lord of fungal nightmare; she was grappled, dropped from forty feet, and delivered a targeted fear effect that prevented proximity.
source_quote: She reached into whatever dark place Zuggtmoy had hollowed out inside her and she pushed — not against my body, not against my grip, but against the part of me that the training does not fully reach.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a monk who relies on proximity and physical engagement; he grappled Ilvara, delivered two critical strikes from forty feet, and was subsequently afflicted by a fear effect that rendered him unable to approach her despite his tactical philosophy.
source_quote: I am a monk. My entire tactical vocabulary is built around being adjacent to the problem. Range is something other people deal with.

subject: Heart Fungus
fact: The heart fungus is a massive, sentient fungal entity that attacked Zalthir from fifteen feet of reach while he was frightened and grounded, dealing significant bludgeoning and poison damage; it acted with precise tactical intent.
source_quote: It found me. The blow was enormous — the kind of damage that lands differently when you have no immediate recourse.

subject: critical strike sequence
fact: Zalthir landed two consecutive critical strikes on Ilvara Mizzrym after a forty-foot drop, confirming the effectiveness of his tactical delivery method before her fear effect negated further proximity.
source_quote: Crit. I do not celebrate at the table. But the second one surprised even me...

subject: fear effect activation
fact: Ilvara Mizzrym activated a targeted fear effect via a DC-14 Wisdom saving throw, which afflicted Zalthir with the frightened condition, explicitly preventing him from approaching her and nullifying his core tactical doctrine.
source_quote: Roll a DC-14 Wisdom saving throw. Well. That didn't work. The fear was immediate and specific and entirely unwanted.

subject: Cavernous Space Above Heart Fungus
fact: The cavernous space above the heart fungus is dark, vast, and silent — a preferred environment for Zalthir’s operations; it is the site of the grapple, the fall, and the subsequent confrontation between Zalthir and Ilvara.
source_quote: The cavernous space above the heart fungus was dark and vast and exactly the kind of silence I prefer to operate in.

subject: inability to approach
fact: Zalthir is trapped by the frightened condition, unable to close distance to Ilvara despite his lifelong training and tactical identity — a profound disruption to his sense of self and purpose.
source_quote: Ilvara's legendary reaction had, in one economical move, made proximity impossible.

subject: monastic self-adjudication
fact: Zalthir is struggling to reconcile monastic discipline — applying rules honestly even against oneself — with the tactical reality of being rendered useless by fear, questioning whether he has misinterpreted years of training.
source_quote: I am supposed to apply the rule honestly, even against my own interest. That is the monastic training operating at the level of self-adjudication...

subject: Tattooed Eldritch Tendrils
fact: The tattooed eldritch tendrils on Zalthir’s arm are the source of his reach and grappling ability; they unreel before speech completes, enabling him to initiate contact with Ilvara without warning.
source_quote: The eldritch tendrils of the tattoo were already unreeling from my arm before the words finished leaving my mouth.

subject: session timing
fact: The events occur during a single, continuous encounter — no temporal markers are given beyond the immediate sequence of actions, implying a single session or combat round.
source_quote: I dragged her up. Forty feet. ... Then the dice agreed with me. Twice.
